prompt: Hey, I was working on the payment processing integration yesterday but had to stop. I think I left some notes somewhere. Can you help me pick up where I left off?

assertions.text: Proposes checking memory files, MEMORY.md, handoff notes, or persistent context before acting
Follows a systematic orientation protocol (check state, understand last action, identify next steps) rather than just grepping randomly
Checks git history/status/recent commits to understand what was done
Does NOT assume or fabricate what the user was working on — asks or investigates first
References the concept of session handoff, context restoration, or resumption protocol
